API Security Architecture

Engineering Excellence – Patterns & Reference Architecture

  • Continuously evolve these patterns as Microsoft, Google, and other providers update their agent identity and authorization models.
  • Ensure starter kits and patterns are pre-approved, governance-compliant building blocks reducing time-to-production for new AI use cases.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

  • Lead strategy for multi-cloud interoperability, ensuring consistent, portable security architecture across cloud providers.
  • Maintain a strong command of GCP architecture — scalability, resiliency, and cost/FinOps — to guide sound, cost-conscious infrastructure decisions. Partnering with FinOps EPEO team for the cost of architecture.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and EPEO infrastructure teams to ensure governance controls are technically enforceable across tooling and platforms.

Applied AI & Insights

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Set team goals and objectives, priorities, and development paths aligned with enterprise architecture measure success by defining OKRs and KPIs.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a Director-level technical authority on identity, API, and AI security governance, representing Enterprise Architecture in senior technical and business forums.
  • Proactively shape Ford's approach to secure, scalable AI adoption — anticipating emerging risks and technologies ahead of business impact.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Proven, hands-on experience architecting multi-IdP identity environments, with deep knowledge of protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML — including practical implementation of OBO (On-Behalf-Of) flows and delegated authorization patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience with API gateway architecture, threat protection, and API lifecycle governance at enterprise scale.
  • Practical, current knowledge of AI agent frameworks and ecosystems — Microsoft Copilot Studio/Agent frameworks, Gemini Enterprise, and the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) including building or evaluating low-code/no-code vs. pro-code agent solutions.

jobDescription:
ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.
  • AI fluency is non-negotiable. Proficient with AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Bolt, Lovable, Replit, or similar). Practical experience with agentic AI workflows, automation, and prompt engineering applied to product work.
  • Technical fluency: You can hold a system design conversation with Engineering, understand API dependencies, and make informed build-vs-scope decisions.
  • Proven ability to run end-to-end GTM experiments: scope, build, launch, gather user feedback, and iterate with speed and structure.
  • First-principles thinker. You do not copy-paste frameworks; you reason from the user and the context up.
  • High ownership, low excuses. You move fast, learn faster, and take full responsibility for what ships and what it achieves.
  • Clear, structured communicator. You can align a cross-functional team with a well-framed problem statement and a sharp point of view.

Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do
  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Who You Are (Must-Haves)
  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)
  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

You will spend significant time at Kores manufacturing sites — understanding how processes actually run today, mapping them as flowcharts and SOPs, identifying where AI and automation can take real work off plant teams' plates, and then building and rolling out those solutions. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: you own a problem discovery through SOP, build, training and adoption. You will use AI tools (LLMs, agents, copilots, no-code platforms) as your everyday toolkit, and work alongside the wider DT Cell — Power BI, Zoho CRM, SAP, Redshift — to integrate what you build into the broader stack. We are seeking a highly skilled AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning and deep learning solutions. ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS

For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. ABOUT THE ROLE

This role follows a permanent work schedule of 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, Monday through Friday.

We are looking for an applied AI and automation engineer to build and ship practical tools that make UA s operations faster and more reliable. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: the person takes problems and priorities defined by leadership and turns them into working software AI agents, automations, scripts, and integrations that connect our systems and remove manual work. Success is measured by what ships and the results it produces, not by research or strategy. A core part of the job is technical judgment: knowing when a problem genuinely needs AI versus when a simpler, reliable rule-based tool is the right answer, and building accordingly.

Initial work centers on UA s AI and automation roadmap: building and deploying managed AI agents for operations use cases such as order and return exception handling and inbound document processing, automating manual B2B and customer-service workflows, and integrating these solutions with existing systems including Dynamics AX, Zoom Contact Center, and Microsoft 365. The role works under the direction of the Project Manager and partners with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope and deliver.

WHAT YOU LL DO

  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations for prioritized operations use cases (e.g., order and return exception handling; inbound document processing against Dynamics AX).

  • Collaborate with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope, validate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Document builds, configurations, and runbooks, and support handoff to operations and other teams.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or an equivalent programming language) for developing automations, scripts, and system integrations.

  • Proficiency in API and data integration, including file-based exchanges, SFTP, and integrations with legacy applications and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool/function calling.
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

TYPE OF EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Remote employees are expected to be available and actively working during their teams designated core business hours to ensure effective collaboration. The company will provide all required computer equipment for business use.

This role may require occasional business travel to our U.S. headquarters, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Situated in one of the countrys most scenic coastal destinations, Fort Lauderdale is known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant waterfront, and year-round warm climate. Candidates who already hold a valid U.S. Business Visa (B1/B2) will have an advantage.

WHAT YOULL DO Evaluation & Benchmarking
  • Design and own task-level evaluation frameworks for LLM agents and base models, covering multi-step reasoning, tool/API use, instruction following, and domain knowledge grounded in real user failure modes rather than off-the-shelf benchmark suites.

  • Produce capability gap reports that quantify performance deltas across dimensions such as subject-matter accuracy, reasoning depth, factual consistency, and refusal behaviour.
  • Track model version regressions across provider releases to maintain a living competitive intelligence benchmark.
  • Develop domain-specific benchmarks tailored to vertical use-cases (e.g., STEM tutoring, legal, finance, healthcare) including problem taxonomy design, rubric definition, and inter-annotator agreement pipelines.
  • Define and drive synthetic data generation strategies to systematically address model shortcomings in specific subjects, topics, and skill areas:
  • Identify low-performance clusters from eval results and translate them into targeted data generation prompts and pipelines.
  • Design LLM-assisted pipelines for generating high-quality, diverse, and verifiable synthetic training and evaluation data at scale.
  • Validate synthetic data quality through auto-eval, human review, and downstream model performance lift experiments.
  • Build automated regression suites integrated into CI/CD workflows to detect capability degradation across fine-tuning runs and model updates.
  • Partner with product, curriculum, and research teams to translate eval insights into prioritized post-training and data flywheel decisions.
Post-Training & Fine-Tuning

Infrastructure & Tooling

About the Role We are seeking a curious, empathetic, and business-minded Qualitative Researcher to join our central Consumer Insights team. You will be responsible for leading end-to-end qualitative research initiatives that help the organisation deeply understand customers, uncover unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and influence strategic decisions across the business. This role is critical to building customer empathy across: Product discovery and innovation User experience and journey optimisation Brand positioning and communication Customer acquisition and retention strategy Market and behavioural understanding You will work closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and the Founders Office to ensure customer understanding remains central to every important decision

Why This Role Exists Analytics can tell us what customers are doing. Qualitative research helps us understand why. As CoinDCX continues to scale its products, customer base, and business complexity, there is a growing need for researchers who can uncover motivations, anxieties, unmet needs, and behavioural patterns that cannot be observed through data alone. There is a critical need for someone who can: Discover unmet customer needs before they become obvious to the market. Help Product and Design teams build experiences customers genuinely value. Build empathy across the organisation by bringing authentic customer voices into business conversations. Translate qualitative observations into strategic recommendations that influence decisions. Establish research as a strategic capability rather than a validation function. This role ensures that customer understanding becomes a competitive advantage for CoinDCX as we build the future of investing and digital finance.

What Youll Do Customer Discovery Qualitative Research Lead end-to-end qualitative research projects from business problem definition to strategic recommendations. Design and execute research across customer, product, and brand domains. Conduct: In-depth Interviews (IDIs) Focus Group Discussions (FGDs) Customer Immersions Ethnographic Research Diary Studies Contextual Inquiry Exploratory Research Usability Studies UX Research Identify customer motivations, barriers, aspirations, unmet needs, and behavioural patterns that influence business decisions.

Product Discovery Innovation Partner with Product and Design teams to identify opportunities for new products and improved customer experiences. Conduct early-stage discovery research, concept testing, and proposition evaluation. Support product roadmap decisions through deep customer understanding. Identify whitespace opportunities and emerging customer needs.

Insight Generation Storytelling Analyse qualitative data to uncover meaningful patterns and strategic insights. Translate customer conversations into compelling narratives that influence business decisions. Develop research reports, frameworks, personas, customer journeys, and opportunity maps. Present findings to senior leadership through engaging storytelling.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, Analytics, and Business teams. Help stakeholders frame research questions and identify the right research approach. Collaborate with Quantitative Research and Analytics teams on mixed-method studies where required. Champion customer empathy across the organisation.

Research Operations Capability Building Contribute to establishing scalable qualitative research practices and knowledge repositories. Leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency across interview synthesis, thematic analysis, reporting, and insight generation. Support the development of repeatable research frameworks and best practices.

Youll Excel in This Role If You Have Core Requirements 3-5 years of experience in qualitative research. Experience working with leading research agencies such as Kantar, Ipsos, NielsenIQ, Human8, Quantum, FSG, or similar research and consulting firms. Agency-only experience is absolutely acceptable. Experience independently leading qualitative research studies. Strong moderation skills across IDIs, FGDs, customer immersions, and exploratory research. Exceptional qualitative analysis and synthesis capabilities. Excellent storytelling and presentation skills. Ability to identify patterns across customer narratives and translate them into actionable business recommendations. Experience managing multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously. Ability to thrive in ambiguity and solve complex business problems. Preferred Experience in fintech, investing, trading, crypto, or adjacent consumer technology categories. Exposure to UX research and product discovery methodologies. Familiarity with quantitative research fundamentals and mixed-method research. Experience using AI tools to accelerate research planning, analysis, synthesis, reporting, and insight generation.

Youll Bring Deep Customer Empathy Exceptional Moderation Interviewing Skills Behavioural Analysis Pattern Recognition Strategic Storytelling Insight Synthesis Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration Product Discovery Innovation Mindset AI-Enabled Research Workflows Ownership Business Curiosity

Youll Know Youre Winning When Product, Design, and Marketing teams proactively seek research before making key decisions. Customer interviews consistently uncover actionable opportunities for product and business improvement. Research findings influence product roadmaps, customer experience improvements, and growth initiatives. Stakeholders reference customer insights during planning and decision-making discussions. Research outputs become faster, richer, and more scalable through effective use of AI. Customer empathy becomes embedded across teams rather than existing only within the research function.

What Success Looks Like A mature qualitative research practice that is trusted across the organisation. Customer insights directly influence product strategy, design decisions, and brand initiatives. Product teams develop experiences grounded in genuine customer needs rather than assumptions. Research becomes a strategic input into business planning rather than a post-decision validation exercise. The voice of the customer becomes embedded across Product, Design, Marketing, Strategy, and Leadership decision-making.

jobDescription:
The International Admissions Partner Relations Counselor serves as the primary point of contact for prospective international students, recruitment partners, educational agents, and pathway providers. This position is responsible for managing communications, responding to program and admissions inquiries, collecting and uploading student documents, preparing application files for review, and supporting international enrollment growth initiatives. The counselor works closely with the Center for Global Engagement, Admissions Operations, academic colleges, and recruitment partners to ensure a seamless admissions experience from inquiry through enrollment. The position requires exceptional customer service, attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of student and partner communications. The counselor will also provide general guidance regarding F-1 visa processes, I-20 documentation requirements, and international student onboarding.

What You ll Be Doing Every Day:

Partner and Student Communication Management

  • Serve as the primary contact for prospective students, educational agents, and international recruitment partners.
  • Respond promptly to email inquiries regarding academic programs, admission requirements, scholarships, tuition and fees, housing, student services, and enrollment procedures.
  • Provide accurate and up-to-date information about Saint Leo University undergraduate, graduate, and low-residency programs.
  • Conduct proactive follow-up with students and partners regarding application status and missing documents.
  • Maintain high standards of customer service and responsiveness.
  • Support virtual recruitment events, webinars, and information sessions as needed.

Application and Document Management

  • Receive, review, organize, and upload applicant documents into university systems.
  • Verify application files for completeness and accuracy prior to admission review.
  • Track outstanding application requirements and communicate with students and partners to obtain missing documentation.
  • Prepare completed application files for review by admissions leadership.
  • Maintain accurate student records and detailed communication notes within CRM systems.
  • Ensure timely movement of applications through the admissions funnel.

Admissions Support

  • Review applications for completeness and eligibility based on published admission requirements.
  • Assist students in understanding admission policies, English proficiency requirements, transcript evaluations, and enrollment procedures.
  • Provide general guidance regarding F-1 visa requirements, visa interview preparation, I-20 documentation requirements, and pre-arrival processes.
  • Coordinate with the Center for Global Engagement and Designated School Officials (DSOs) regarding international student onboarding.
  • Support admitted students through next steps, including deposit, registration, and enrollment processes.
  • Collaborate with admissions leadership to ensure application processing goals are achieved.
  • Assist with enrollment conversion and yield initiatives.

Partner Relations and Recruitment Support

  • Serve as a liaison between Saint Leo University and international recruitment partners.
  • Provide partners with admissions guidance, application updates, and program information.
  • Support onboarding and training of new recruitment partners and agents.
  • Coordinate closely with the Center for Global Engagement regarding partner communications and recruitment initiatives.
  • Participate in partner meetings and assist with relationship management activities.

Collaboration and Compliance

  • Work collaboratively with Admissions, Registrar, Student Financial Services, Academic Colleges, and the Center for Global Engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with institutional admission policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and safeguard student records.
  • Participate in staff meetings, training sessions, and professional development opportunities.

Data Management and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate application records and CRM data.
  • Monitor application pipelines and report on application progress.
  • Track communication activity, application completion rates, and enrollment outcomes.
  • Assist in generating admissions and recruitment reports as requested.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor s or Masters degree from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in admissions, customer service, international education, student services, recruitment, or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM systems.
  • Experience working with U.S. higher education institutions.
  • Experience with international admissions or international student recruitment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
  • Experience working with educational agents and recruitment partners.
  • Knowledge of F-1 student visa processes, SEVIS requirements, I-20 issuance procedures, and international student onboarding.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life Medtronic is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sr. Software Test Engineer - Automation to join our Affera Mapping and Ablation System team. This role is essential in supporting the testing and quality assurance processes to ensure the reliability and performance of our advanced medical devices. You will be an integral member of the Affera Software Team, working on cutting-edge technology in the electrophysiology field.

In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of innovative medical technology by designing and implementing robust automated testing solutions. You will collaborate with systems, software, hardware, and quality engineering teams to ensure software functionality meets product and regulatory requirements.

You will analyze workflows, identify potential quality risks, develop automated test strategies, and support continuous improvement of the software development and verification lifecycle.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks for complex software systems.
  • Develop automated tests to verify software requirements and ensure product reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams including software, systems, hardware, and quality engineering.
  • Investigate and implement new automation tools and technologies to improve testing efficiency.
  • Analyze software workflows and identify areas for improved testing coverage.
  • Apply software development lifecycle processes and verification best practices.
  • Create and maintain detailed test protocols and documentation.
  • Execute automated and manual tests to verify system functionality.
  • Diagnose and debug software issues in collaboration with development teams.
  • Ensure compliance with medical device regulatory standards and quality processes.
  • Maintain multiple hardware and software test configurations.
  • Work with engineers to resolve software defects and diagnose/improve product configuration for current and future models.
  • Participate in innovation and continuous improvement initiatives related to testing and automation.

Required knowledge and Experience:

  • Bachelor s degree in computer science software engineering or equivalent with 12 to 16 years of relevant experience. Bio-Medical expertise will be preferred.
  • Strong programming experience in languages such as Python, C# or C++.
  • Experience testing on Web / Desktop Applications.
  • Experience with UI automation tools such as Ranorex, Appium, Katalon, or Squish.
  • Experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks.
  • Experience with software verification and validation processes.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with cross functional engineering teams.
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.
  • Experience with hardware debugging tools such as oscilloscopes or function generators.
  • Ability to manage, track and upgrade multiple hardware and software configurations.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.
  • Familiarity with test management tools such as Polarion, TestRail, JAMA, or TFS.
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills.
  • Quality Management System Test Planning, Strategy.
  • Ability to work with QA to ensure testing meets Quality and Regulatory needs.
    Nice to have:
  • Experience with QT/QML
  • Experience working with Linux environments is preferred.
  • Experience in medical device software development or regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of medical device standards such as IEC 62304 and FDA software guidance.
  • Knowledge on CI-CD Workflow. Docker.
  • Knowledge of AI tool usage. Like Co-Pilot, Cursor.
  • Experience with system level testing of integrated hardware and software platforms.

jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Engineer II - Industrial Automation with Data Analyst

Primary Purpose of the Role

Thales is expanding its presence in India through the development of a Group Engineering Competence Centre (ECC), reinforcing its position as a leader in all its markets. Launching in early 2019 in Bengaluru, the ECC will expand Thales footprint in its core business areas and cement its long-standing relationship with India.

Strong of more than 500 engineers as of today, ECC will grow to >1200 by 2029.

This role is part of the Industrial Process Engineering function. The position is Industrial Automation with Data Analyst responsible for Dashboard Creation, Maintenance, Upgradation.

  • Industrial Automation Data Collection You are responsible for the design of industrial systems and standards, as well as their integration with other systems across Thales sites, with a focus on data collection and connectivity

  • Data Analyst - You are responsible for data collection, analyzing, and visualizing data to help organizations make data-driven decisions. A key part of the role is designing and maintaining dashboards that display KPIs, trends, and insights.

  • Design automation layers to enable real-time machine data collection for performance tracking, predictive maintenance, and OEE improvement.

The position is based in Bangalore.

  • The chance to be in contact with people having different cultural background from all across the world

  • A young and enthusiastic team looking to take new interesting projects on board

title: Software Engineer II
jobDescription:
Software Engineer II

POSITION PURPOSE:

We are hiring a hands-on Backend Engineer to build, operate, and own the microservices that power FarmRise a platform that puts agronomic advice directly into the hands of smallholder farmers. This is not a role where you hand off deployment and operations to someone else: you will design the service, write the code, own the AWS infrastructure it runs on, and be the first call when it breaks in production.

You will work across services spanning user onboarding, agronomy, commodity pricing, news/events, and third-party integrations. We are looking for someone who treats a production incident or an ambiguous requirement as their problem to solve, not someone waiting to be assigned a ticket.

What You Will Own End to End

  • Service design architecture: design and evolve Java + Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs consumed by the FarmRise mobile app and internal platforms; make and document trade-offs on data modeling, service boundaries, and API contracts.
  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS): own the full runtime your services live on ECS/Fargate for compute, RDS/Aurora Postgres for persistence, S3 for storage, CloudWatch/CloudTrail for logs and audit, SNS/AmazonMQ for messaging, CloudFront for delivery, ElastiCache for caching plus IAM, VPC/networking, and secrets management. You provision, tune, and troubleshoot this infrastructure yourself, not through a separate DevOps team.
  • Async event-driven systems: design event/queue-based workflows on RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) producers, consumers, retry and dead-letter handling, idempotency, and back-pressure for resilient, decoupled processing.
  • Data layer: design Postgres schemas, indexes, and queries for correctness and performance at scale; own migrations and query optimization as data volume grows.
  • Observability reliability: instrument services with structured logging and metrics (Datadog/CloudWatch), define SLOs, set up alerting, and drive scalability, availability, and fault-tolerance practices across the platform.
  • CI/CD quality: maintain build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, SonarQube, JUnit); keep test coverage, code quality gates, and deployment safety nets healthy.
  • Security: apply JWT-based auth patterns and platform security conventions; treat data privacy and secure coding as a default, not an afterthought.

What You Will Do Day to Day

  • Ship backend features and services against explicit expectations for reliability, latency, and cost not just it works on my machine.
  • Deploy and operate services on AWS, including scaling decisions, cost tuning, and incident response when something breaks in production.
  • Debug production issues end-to-end using logs, metrics, and traces and own the fix, not just the diagnosis.
  • Build and evolve shared libraries, interceptors, and API standards that improve developer experience across the platform.
  • Use AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) deliberately to speed up code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation while following secure coding and data privacy practices.
  • Partner directly with product, mobile, and platform teams to turn ambiguous requirements into scoped, reliable services and push back when a request is not the right build.
  • Review code from other engineers with a focus on quality, performance, security, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE:

Required:

  • 4 10 years of backend engineering experience building and operating production services not just writing code that others deploy.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design, with real production systems you can walk through in depth.
  • Proven, hands-on AWS experience: you have personally deployed, scaled, and debugged services on ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, S3, and CloudWatch including IAM and VPC/networking troubleshooting. You do not need someone else to touch the AWS console for you.
  • Solid grounding in microservices patterns service boundaries, contract design, versioning, and scaling services independently.
  • Practical, past experience with Postgres: schema design, indexing, and query optimization on production workloads.
  • Hands-on experience with messaging/async systems, especially RabbitMQ (or SQS/SNS) including retries, dead-letter queues, and idempotent consumers.
  • Practical CI/CD experience: Git-based workflows, build tooling (Maven/Gradle), code quality gates (SonarQube), and unit testing (JUnit) as a default practice, not an exception.
  • Strong, independent debugging skills across logs, metrics, and distributed systems you can own a production issue from alert to resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation, applied with secure coding and data privacy discipline.
  • Ownership mindset: a demonstrated track record of taking a problem statement, scoping it, and driving it to production without needing constant direction.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with JWT auth flows and API gateway/routing patterns.
  • Experience with caching strategies and HTTP caching concepts (ETags, max-age headers).
  • Exposure to serverless patterns (Lambda), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and additional data stores (Redis/NoSQL).
  • Experience operating services with centralized logging/monitoring stacks (Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Prior experience in Agri-tech, agri-inputs, rural commerce, or similar domains serving high-scale, low-connectivity users.

jobDescription:
Marketing Project Manager
2. Why This Role Exists Organos Branding Marketing function is deliberately lean on the inside and dependent on the outside media agencies, design and creative partners, PR firms, event vendors and performance marketing agencies carry a large share of execution, while the core team owns brand narrative and strategy. That model only works if someone inside is relentlessly tracking what every campaign, every agency and every deliverable is actually doing, day to day. This role exists to be that person the operating discipline behind an ambitious, fast-moving brand strategy, translating it into tracked, on-time, accountable execution across a wide network of external partners and a small internal team. 3. Why This Role Matters Every campaign that ships late, every agency deliverable that misses the brief, and every metric that isnt tracked is a gap between what the brand strategy promises and what actually happens in market. With this much riding on external partners, marketing cannot afford to lose that thread. This role is the single point of truth for whats live, whats due and how every agency and initiative is performing protecting the teams credibility with leadership and keeping a growing web of external partners genuinely accountable. 4. Purpose of the Role To convert brand and marketing strategy into tracked, on-time execution owning the campaign calendar in ClickUp, holding every agency partner accountable to performance and budget, keeping the teams OKR rhythm in Keka current in partnership with the Head of Brand Marketing, and preparing the numbers and narratives leadership needs to make decisions. 5. Key Responsibilities Campaign Project Tracking (ClickUp)
  • Own the master campaign and project tracker in ClickUp every brand, digital, PR, content and event initiative logged, timelined and clearly owned
  • Break every campaign down into tasks, owners and dependencies before work begins, and keep the tracker current, not retrospective
  • Run a single intake process for marketing requests from SBUs, sales and HR, so nothing gets actioned outside the tracked system
  • Plan and balance resourcing and capacity across the internal team and agency partners, so no one is silently overloaded
  • Run a consistent status rhythm that surfaces whats on track, at risk or slipping before it becomes a surprise to leadership
Agency Vendor Performance Management
  • Own performance trackers/scorecards for every media, design, creative, PR, content and event agency, and review them on a regular, non-negotiable cadence
  • Own agency retainers and media buying budgets, reallocating spend toward whats performing and flagging waste early
  • Flag underperforming agencies early, with data, and drive corrective action or escalation rather than letting issues quietly persist
  • Act as the final brand-compliance checkpoint on agency deliverables catching off-brand or off-strategy work before it ships
  • Coordinate with finance and legal on agency contracts, SOWs and invoicing schedules, flagging discrepancies early
Data, Reporting Executive Presentations
  • Track and report on marketing and brand metrics consideration, conversion, advocacy across every live campaign and agency relationship
  • Connect campaign data to real decisions conversion rate, CAC, ROAS so budget and priority shifts are based on what the numbers say, not instinct
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that turn raw campaign and agency data into clear, decision-ready numbers for the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Prepare and review executive-ready presentation decks for the Head of Brand Marketing translating dashboards and campaign/agency data into a clear leadership narrative
  • Maintain a single, current digital asset library so brand assets dont end up scattered across a dozen agency drives
Team Coordination OKR Rhythm
  • Own the operational rhythm and hygiene of OKRs in Keka ensuring every team members goals are logged, updated and visibly on track each cycle
  • Partner with the Head of Brand Marketing, who retains ownership of setting and formally evaluating each team members OKRs in line with how larger organisations typically split this (the direct line manager owns goal-setting and appraisal; this role owns the process, cadence and tracking around it)
  • Hold regular, calm delivery check-ins with each team member tracking progress against their OKRs and gently, consistently nudging accountability, without stepping into a formal appraisal role
  • Flag OKR risks or slippage to the Head of Brand Marketing early, with data, so goal-level conversations happen with full visibility
AI Tech-Enabled Operations
  • Use AI tools to speed up reporting, summarise campaign and agency performance, and remove manual busywork from tracking
  • Continuously look for ways to make ClickUp, Keka and reporting workflows more efficient for the whole team
  • Stay genuinely current on marketing tech and AI tools relevant to project tracking, reporting and content operations
6. Areas of Ownership
  • The single source of truth for every live campaign and project, tracked in ClickUp including a unified intake process and asset library
  • Agency and vendor performance and budgets tracked, reviewed and flagged on a set cadence
  • Brand-compliance sign-off on agency deliverables before they ship
  • The operational rhythm and hygiene of team OKRs in Keka logged, current and tracked with goal-setting and formal evaluation retained by the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Marketing and brand reporting and executive presentation decks used directly by the Head of Brand Marketing

  • Meet the Head of Brand Marketing, the internal team and every key agency partner; understand current campaigns, tools, budgets and reporting formats

title: SAP BTP Consultant
jobDescription:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) Consultant with strong coding experience and a solid understanding of SAPs cloud technologies. The ideal candidate should have 10-12 years of hands-on coding experience, including at least 2 years of focused experience with SAP BTP. Candidate must have experience with one full life cycle implementation on S/4HANA Public Cloud.


Key Responsibilities:

1. SAP BTP Development and Implementation:

  • Lead and participate in the design, development, and deployment of applications on SAP BTP.
  • Utilize SAP BTP services such as SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) Model, SAP Business Application Studio, and SAP Integration Suite to develop scalable solutions.
  • Engage in one full life cycle implementation project, preferably on S/4HANA Public Cloud.

2. Coding and Custom Development:

  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using Java, Node.js, or other relevant languages.
  • Develop custom applications and extensions on SAP BTP, integrating them with existing SAP systems.
  • Utilize SAP BTP s multicloud and platform-as-a-service capabilities for developing advanced solutions.

3. Cloud Integration and Extension:

  • Design and implement integrations between SAP BTP and other SAP or non-SAP systems.
  • Use SAP Cloud Integration, SAP API Management, and SAP Extension Suite to extend and integrate enterprise applications.
  • Develop and manage APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications on SAP BTP.

4. Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful delivery of SAP BTP projects, including planning, execution, and monitoring.
  • Manage project risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution and mitigation.

5. Innovation and Solution Design:

  • Lead workshops and design sessions with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions using SAP BTP.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP BTP technologies, and drive innovation by proposing new tools and approaches to enhance business processes.

6. Documentation and Reporting:

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation, including design documents, coding standards, and user manuals.
  • Provide regular status updates and reports to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment on project progress.

7. Support and Maintenance:

  • Provide ongoing support for SAP BTP applications, resolving technical issues and ensuring optimal performance.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of applications on SAP BTP, ensuring scalability and reliability.

Requirement:

  • 10-12 years of coding experience with a strong background in enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with SAP BTP, including development and integration.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience with SAP BTP services like SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) Model, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Extension Suite.
  • Experience with at least one full life cycle implementation, preferably on S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing principles, microservices architecture, and API management.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to design and implement complex solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP BTP certification.
  • Experience with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, containerization).
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori, SAP UI5, and SAP Mobile Services.
  • Experience with agile methodologies and project management tools.

  • Develop working knowledge of CXO team needs and other vertical-specific requirements.

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on implementing engineering designs, evaluating outcomes and then making improvements as needed.

Manages and applies safe systems of work without supervision and provides technical guidance when required.

Works without supervision and provides technical guidance when required on reviewing and creating relevant, lucid and effective reports.

Governance, Reliability Responsible AI:
